verdicts.evidence: All three outlined cards run from about y=160 to y=600 (about 440 px), and each button ends near y=394, which leaves an empty outlined area of about 200 px below every button.
Each card gives its distance, terrain, climbs, surface, bikes or amenities inside one prose sentence, in a different order on each card, with no separate label-and-value line and no time estimate.
The page has only a plain sans-serif heading, grey body text, pale-outlined white cards and identical blue "View route" buttons, with no imagery, colour or branding tied to coast, woodland or water.
